subject: Borealis launch — draft quote + embargo window
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Lin <sofia.lin@borealis.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-15T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Borealis launch — draft quote + embargo window

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for agreeing to be a launch customer for the Borealis integration. Attached is a short draft quote we would love to include in our launch announcement, plus a proposed embargo timeline (we're planning coordinated PR outreach).

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm the final quote text (or suggest edits) by EOD today?
- Are you able to approve an embargo until 2026-04-22 09:00 PT?
- Can you share the preferred speaker name, title, and a headshot (high-res) for the announcement?

Attachments: borealis-quote-v2.txt (text), press-embargo-timeline.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — looping in Marissa (PR) and Logan (Legal) to keep approvals tight.

Best,
Ava Chen
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com
From: Sofia Lin <sofia.lin@borealis.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: press@borealis.ai
Date: 2026-04-15T14:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Borealis launch — draft quote + embargo window

Thanks, Ava — excited to participate. I reviewed the draft and offered a small tweak to tighten the claim about performance. Our preferred final quote is below; please use it as-is if it fits: 
"Partnering with Redwood Inference has cut our production inference latency by over 40%, allowing us to deliver faster features to customers without compromising model fidelity."

We can agree to an embargo until 2026-04-22 09:00 PT. For the speaker details: Sofia Lin, VP Marketing, Borealis.ai — I can send a high-res headshot and two-sentence bio by Tuesday 4/20.

If Legal needs to tweak the wording for compliance, let me know — otherwise this quote is approved.

Best,
Sofia Lin
VP, Marketing
Borealis.ai
sofia.lin@borealis.ai

Thanks, Sofia — this is great and the timing works for our team. I've taken the approved text and made a tiny editorial tweak to reduce superlatives; see redline attached (quote-redline-v3.txt). Proposed final quote below for sign-off:

Partnering with Redwood Inference has reduced our production inference latency by over 40%, enabling us to deliver faster features to customers without sacrificing model fidelity.

Logan — do we need any legal-safe language here beyond what Sofia approved? If not, I'll queue this for the press release and coordinate with Emma at PressWorks for distribution under the embargo window (2026-04-22 09:00 PT).

Sofia — once you confirm the final sentence above and send a headshot/bio, we'll add Borealis to the release and share the embargo assets (release draft, social copy).

—Marissa
Director, Communications
Redwood Inference

Thanks — small compliance note. Suggest replacing "reduced" with "helped reduce" in the final quote so it reads as a customer result rather than an absolute product claim. Proposed wording: 

"Partnering with Redwood Inference helped reduce our production inference latency by over 40%, enabling us to deliver faster features to customers without sacrificing model fidelity."

If Sofia is comfortable with that phrasing, I'll sign off from Legal. Otherwise we'll need a short attestation from Borealis for the metric source.

– Logan
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

Hi Sofia — thanks for the quick turnaround and for approving the quote. Per Logan's legal note I made the small wording change to a customer-attribution style so we have Legal sign-off. Below is the consolidated final quote we plan to publish (please confirm by reply):

Partnering with Redwood Inference helped reduce our production inference latency by over 40%, enabling us to deliver faster features to customers without sacrificing model fidelity.

Embargo: confirmed until 2026-04-22 09:00 PT.
Next steps: I will send the press draft and social assets to you and Emma at PressWorks on Tuesday 4/20 for review. Sofia — can you send a high-res headshot and a two-sentence bio by EOD 2026-04-20?
